bio: Santa Riccio, whose surname is also written Rizzo, lived at San Mango di Aquino, Catanzaro, Calabria, Italy. She died there on 8 September 1668, when her burial was entered in the San Mango parish register. She is John's 12th-great-grandmother.
funFacts: Burials in 1668 (49) and 1669 (52) were several times the normal level: an epidemic year in San Mango.
